missables.body: The only trophy any guide flags as potentially missable. One meditation at Jason's house is only available during Chapter 1 (see Step 1). The other 17 spots are never missable. It is still unconfirmed whether the Chapter 1 meditation is actually required for the trophy — PowerPyx's author had done it when the trophy popped. Do it in Chapter 1 and never worry about it again.
missables.name: Positive Mental Attitude

notes: Optional missions (black icons with pink letters) disappear after a while, and some quest givers go temporarily unavailable — none of it locks any trophy. All trophy-related characters are available again later.
Some fences disappear permanently, and a few magazine collectibles sit in story buildings that become inaccessible — neither affects any trophy or the 100% checklist.
Time-sensitive quests (hourglass icon) can fail, but they are not trophy-relevant.
Criminal Profile only changes how police treat you. Avoid the permanent Irredeemable profile — cops get far more aggressive.
The Jason/Lucia relationship status does not matter for any trophy.
Using any cheat disables trophies and saving. Cheats only unlock after the story anyway.

steps.body: Finish the 5 chapters and enjoy the game. The 100% checklist is not viewable until after the story, but any progress you make during it already counts. There are no mission gold medals, so you do not need to watch for hidden objectives. Scan vehicles and study animals as you go. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter (15 manual slots + 1 autosave; there is no mission replay).
steps.title: Play the story — and catch the one missable meditation
steps.watch: In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen in the morning and walks to the balcony. Follow her and choose Accept. This is the one meditation that becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1, and it may be required for Positive Mental Attitude. Everything else can wait until free-roam.

steps.body: After the story, the checklist unlocks at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. It is lenient — closer to 60% true completion. Most side quests and collectible types are not fully required, and you only need 70 of 80 Challenges (skip the hardest 10). The only tasks that need everything are Robberies, Underwater Discoveries, Shooting Ranges, Drone Races and Bret's Quests. Do any 100 Optional Missions (there are 200–300+); scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles; study 100 of 255 animals.
steps.title: 100% Completion Checklist + 70 of 80 Challenges
steps.watch: Nothing on the checklist is missable. If you did the side content as it appeared during the story, most of this is already done.

steps.body: Most trophies pop automatically while finishing the checklist. What is usually left: the 8 Strangers & Freaks strands that count (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete), the side-character questlines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret), and any stragglers like 50 Challenges, 250 Stunts or the 5 bank vaults. All of it is still available in free-roam after the story.
steps.title: Strangers & Freaks and miscellaneous cleanup
steps.watch: Check the tracker: sort by 'not earned' and work down the list.
